height_policy: All bridge positions have y=0 as an explicit placeholder. Runtime must drape land/approach on Atlas terrain, sea on sea surface, and preserve the two game-connection exceptions. Do not treat y=0 as walkable ground.
display_policy: Route/node overlay is separate from city models. Hide the overlay inside architecture at runtime if needed; do not change formal endpoints or add stop IDs.
scope: Correct formal identities and geographic centerlines. Not a pawn-clearance, gradient, collision, bridge-engineering, ancient-harbor, or historical-navigation certification.
